Brand Identity & Style Guide

CHAIRVANA

“Where your schedule finds its flow.”

Salon Management & Appointment Booking · chairvana.app

1. Brand Essence & Positioning

Chairvana blends the defining symbol of the beauty industry (Chair) with effortless calm (Nirvana). Most salon booking tools feel cluttered, loud, or overly transactional. Chairvana stands apart as a serene, editorial workspace that turns chaotic calendars into smooth daily rhythm.

Core Brand Promise
Give salon owners and independent stylists calm operational control—and give their clients a frictionless, spa-like booking experience from the first tap to the chair.

Calm Utility

Dark-mode editorial polish paired with zero-clutter scheduling so busy stylists stay focused on clients, not screens.

Effortless Flow

Every interaction—from cascading hair-to-water motion to one-tap confirmations—removes friction from the calendar.

Boutique Craft

Designed to look at home inside upscale studios, independent suites, and modern barbershops—never like generic enterprise software.

2. Logo System & Responsive Hierarchy

The primary Cascade Mark merges a reclined salon chair, a serene figure, and flowing hair pouring like a waterfall into a tranquil pool below. Because fine silhouettes lose clarity at tiny sizes, Chairvana uses a 2-tier responsive logo system across large and small canvases.

Primary Dark Lockup (Hero & Flagship)

Soft Ivory on Matte Obsidian · No accent orb

Inverted Light Lockup (Print & Light UI)

Obsidian Ink on Soft Pearl Paper

Compact Mark for App Icons & Favicons

Mobile App Icon (Dark)

Pure Silk Flow · iOS & Android

Mobile App Icon (Light)

Soft Pearl · Light-mode UI & receipts

Browser Favicon

16×16px & 32×32px tabs

  • Clearspace: Keep breathing room equal to at least the height of the letter C in CHAIRVANA on all four sides.
  • Minimum Size: Use the full Cascade Mark at 140px width or larger; switch to the Compact Wave Mark below 140px.
  • Protect the Silhouette: Never stretch the proportions, add drop shadows, re-introduce extra orbs, or place the mark over busy photography without a dark scrim.

4. Motion & Micro-Interaction Language

Motion in Chairvana mirrors calm water—smooth, unhurried, and purposeful. Use subtle wave choreography in three signature moments while keeping everyday booking taps fast and responsive:

  • Landing Page Tide Draw-In: On initial page load, draw the Cascade silhouette via CSS/SVG stroke-dashoffset over 2.2s with a gentle ease-out curve before softly filling the mark.
  • Hair-to-Waterfall Loop: Clip translucent mist-water streams inside the hair silhouette flowing continuously downward into soft expanding ellipses in the pool below.
  • Confirm Appointment Ripple: When a client taps Confirm Appointment, spawn three staggered concentric ripples from the tap coordinates alongside a stroke-drawn checkmark.

5. Brand Voice, Feature Naming & Touchpoints

Chairvana speaks like a composed, capable studio manager—warm, reassuring, and free of cluttered jargon. Pair the core slogan (“Where your schedule finds its flow.”) with clear, memorable product language.

Context On-Brand Copy & Signature Naming
Hero Headline Chairvana — Where your schedule finds its flow.
Salon Owner Pitch Full chairs. Quiet mind. Automated waitlists, zero double-books, and calm daily rhythm.
Client Booking You’re all set—see you in the chair. (Booking confirmation & SMS reminder)
Signature Features Ghost Chair Rescue (auto-fill cancellations), Chair Memory (color formulas & client notes), Quiet Zen Mode (silent-appointment toggle), Chair Pass (vanity link chairvana.app/studio).

High-Impact Digital & In-Salon Touchpoints

Vanity Booking Links & Bio Kit

Promote chairvana.app/your-salon as a clean, dark-mode booking page stylists are proud to feature in Instagram and TikTok bios.

Translucent Mirror QR Clings

Minimalist die-cut mirror decals showing the Cascade wave and a QR code: “Love the look? Book your next visit before you leave the chair.”

Matte Black Salon Merch

Subtle ivory Cascade mark on matte-black styling capes, appointment cards, and acrylic countertop plaques that blend into upscale studio decor.

Annual “Chair Wrapped”

Shareable year-end recap cards highlighting chairs filled, top services, and client loyalty—turning stylists and clients into organic advocates.
